# Learn Kata AI

> Personalized AI study mentor that builds adaptive study plans, teaches like a tutor, and grades exam-style quizzes strictly so students walk into their exam ready.

Learn Kata AI is a free study platform for students preparing for real exams. It builds a daily roadmap around your weak subjects, runs an AI tutor that teaches step-by-step, and uses strict-marked quizzes to track real mastery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Learn Kata AI and how the personalized AI study mentor works.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create a free account to get a personalized study plan.
